title: WiFi Activity Recognition: A Universal Framework for CSI-based Human Activity Recognition
description: WiFi Activity Recognition is a Python package for CSI-based human activity recognition. It provides a hardware abstraction layer, preprocessing and feature utilities, train/evaluate/predict workflows, and research modules for adaptation and federated learning.

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
